from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A paper from the collection with its metadata and reference list."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    year: str | None = Field(description="The publication year of this paper")
    cites_titles: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of papers referenced in this document's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
